_comment: Hand-authored Bulgarian dishes. Every dish value is the sum of its ingredients (per 100 g, short keys: cal/c/p/f/sat/sug/fib/salt), divided by cooked_grams - the weight of the finished dish. Values come from standard Bulgarian recipe proportions and are auditable by recomputing this file.
